entry_state: Eliminating an intragroup loan does not erase the currency exposure of the group's cash; settlement facts decide profit versus OCI. Eliminations require identified events and nonduplicated allocations. Hyperinflation restatement preserves monetary purchasing-power loss before translation. Exchangeability now requires currency direction,date and purpose rather than a quote alone.
exit_state: Exchangeability depends on the entity, currency direction, date and purpose. An estimated rate must meet the measurement objective; transition retained earnings and translation-reserve adjustments differ. These documentary methods require an explicit successor exchange. Chapter 11 now tests credit losses and the bank balance sheet.
findings: Page 243 was actually viewed before the context handoff; this record preserves that reading without rerendering or granting earlier-version credit.
The amendment date and purpose-specific evidence constrain rate selection. Five obtainable against one thousand needed is judgment evidence, not a universal numerical threshold.
The conditional 0.08 rate produces 80; observable 0.10 and 0.09 quotes do not establish either substitutability or the validity of 0.08. Unknown support remains unresolved.

Initial monetary-liability adjustment of 200 affects opening retained earnings; the separate foreign-operation decrease of 20 affects accumulated translation differences. The distinction prevents a generic equity posting rule.
No new defect is confirmed. Source applicability is assessed as presented in the frozen manuscript, not independently revalidated here.

sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.entry_belief: Restatement must precede translation, but a visible quote may not be usable for the required exchange.
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.open_question: What evidence supports exchangeability and an estimated rate when the required currency cannot be obtained?
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.parent_contribution: Adds date-, direction- and purpose-specific rate admission and separates transition from subsequent accounting.
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.belief_update: Ability differs from intention; estimated rates require support for orderly exchange at the measurement date.
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.exit_question: How will a successor exchange bind these additional assessments and histories?
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.removal_verdict: Removal would leave translation able to accept an irrelevant quote and obscure amendment transition.
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.swap_verdict: Keep after hyperinflation restatement because rate choice acts on the resulting balances.
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.entry_verdict: The preceding currency discussion supplies amounts, dates and presentation purposes before the new test.
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.exit_verdict: The final scope statement preserves the closed GroupForeignOperation/1 exchange boundary.
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.promise_verdict: The section supplies conditional calculations and unresolved evidence treatment without promising a universal estimator.
sections/group-restatement-exchangeabili.distinct_contribution_verdict: Its contribution is exchangeability and transition evidence, distinct from restatement arithmetic.

chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.entry_belief: Operating histories already show why totals and balanced journals cannot identify a whole company.
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.open_question: How do financing, ownership and group boundaries change measurement and the histories required?
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.parent_contribution: Connects debt and EPS to awards, hedges, tax, control and foreign-operation lifecycles.
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.belief_update: Dated rights, reserve origins, tax bases and group overlays matter even when terminal cash or equity agrees.
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.exit_question: How do these distinctions constrain a bank's allowance, capital and distributable cash?
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.removal_verdict: Removal would omit the ownership and group mechanisms needed for whole-company reconstruction.
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.swap_verdict: Keep after operating methods and before banking, whose capital and transfer problems depend on these distinctions.
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.entry_verdict: Debt disclosures provide a concrete continuation from operating-company reconstruction.
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.exit_verdict: Currency methods finish with explicit evidence and interface limits before the sector change.
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.promise_verdict: Detailed examples support their stated domains; general hedge attribution and nonadditive EPS selection stay open.
chapters/14-financing-groups.tex:chapter.distinct_contribution_verdict: The chapter establishes financing and ownership histories plus group-only measurement that cannot be recovered from a single ledger.
